name: Fursuit Dummy
check: A friend's spare fursuit on a coat rack. The friend wants it back.

acts.label: Talk
acts.text: * It doesn't seem much for conversation. It's busy vibing.

acts.label: Shake to the Bass
acts.text: * You bob your head to the bass. The dummy sways along.
useTexts: * You bob your head to the bass. The dummy sways along.
* You shake harder. The coat rack rattles in rhythm.
* You go all in. Furiell joins in, bouncing on her paws.

acts.label: Turn It Down
acts.text: * You turn the bass down. The dummy stops swaying and slumps. It looks sad.

acts.label: Accept Hug
acts.text: * You hug the dummy. It's damp. FUR +10.

default: * Fursuit Dummy sways on its coat rack.
* The bass rattles the dummy's fluffy ears.
* The damp fursuit head nods along to a beat only it can hear.
spareable: * Fursuit Dummy is bobbing along happily. It doesn't want to fight.
* The bass has mellowed out. The dummy looks content.
* Fursuit Dummy sways gently, waiting for the next song.

deathText: * The dummy collapses into faux fur and regret.
